native_clearance.adjacent_join_scope: Original adjacent physical-joint mesh pairs and unchanged same-frame model joins are retained, not zero intersections; changed nonadjacent pairs are never waived by a baseline pair label.

witness.method: native triangle centroid inward250um, both entire native meshes winding/depth

limitations: No pickup/withdrawal, gait, moving contact, world route, packing or Scene/controller acceptance.
Native self-clearance probes are bounded, not a complete intersection or swept collision certificate.
Original adjacent and rigid same-frame model joins are retained explicitly; no overall zero-intersection claim.
Two opposed pad contacts assume synthetic friction. No force, stability, fatigue, comfort, ergonomic or legal manual-handling certification.
Some wrist axes reach original limits; no bound was widened.
Root visual review and subsequent workflow admission remain separate.
